items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: he was a guest on The Tonight Show with Garfunkel. I got a call, I was home, and they said we need a bass guitar and you’re the one that made the record or something. So I had to race in play that one number with them.

ctx.x: Yeah he actually had his first duo, it was called Tom and Jerry I think, and he didn’t really make it at that point, maybe that’s what you were talking about.

I actually played with him once, I had forgotten, I had played with so many different people that I had made a record with him and he was a guest on The Tonight Show with Garfunkel. I got a call, I was home, and they said we need a bass guitar and you’re the one that made the record or something. So I had to race in play that one number with them.
